AI Engineered for Lawyers

Clio delivers intelligence that understands the law. Transform your legal research, litigation, and transactions with precision-engineered AI that adapts to your workflows and delivers reliable insights. Backed by the world's most comprehensive legal database.

Book a Demo Start a Free Trial
Working with the world's leading innovators
Legal Intelligence That Sets You Apart

Clio gives lawyers at firms of all sizes, from AmLaw 100 to boutique practices, the power to work smarter, move faster and unleash their ingenuity. Our AI delivers precise, actionable intelligence when you need it, backed by 25+ years of legal data expertise.

About Us

Transform How You Work

Clio delivers comprehensive legal intelligence solutions that change how legal professionals research, analyze and practice law.

View All

Vincent by Clio

AI engineered for lawyers that transforms legal research, litigation and transactions, backed by the global legal database.

Learn More

Clio Library

Access over one billion legal documents from more than 100 countries on one research platform with advanced search.

Learn More

Clio Docket

Search 850+ million court records with real-time alerts, litigation analytics and APIs for custom integrations and automated workflows.

Learn More
01

Research in Minutes, Not Hours

Ask natural language questions and receive comprehensive answers with proper citations. Generate 50-state surveys instantly. Build persuasive arguments with supporting authority.

02

Documents That Work Harder

Analyze contracts and identify risks. Extract key insights from complaints and depositions. Compare document versions with legal context for each change.

03

Litigation Intelligence at Your Fingertips

Profile judges, opposing counsel, and parties using 850+ million court records. Find winning templates from similar cases. Transform court recordings into actionable strategic intelligence.

See All Capabilities
"At the very core, working with Clio(formerly vLex) has been about relationships. Yes – the technology is stellar. Our lawyers love Vincent AI. But, the true measure of excellence is the depth of human connection. Clio(formerly vLex) is a partner in every sense of the word."

Sarah Hirebet, Director of Knowledge Management

Stradley Ronon
Integration & Security

Enterprise-Ready by Design

Vincent by Clio integrates with Microsoft Word, Outlook, iManage and more. SOC2 and ISO 27001 certified.

Learn More
Custom AI Solutions

Partner with Clio

Our in-house legal AI experts work with you on custom workflows, analytics and integrations.

  • Co-develop proprietary workflows tailored to your specific challenges

  • Optimize data preparation for seamless integration of your internal knowledge

  • Collaborate directly with world-class legal AI and legal tech experts

Learn More
Coverage

Unmatched Global Content Depth

Clio Library gives access to over one billion documents across 100+ countries.

United States

Access comprehensive U.S. legal content through Clio's platform. Featuring complete federal and state case law, codes, regulations, secondary materials from 250+ publishers, and daily updates across 400+ courts—all enhanced by advanced AI workflows and intelligent search capabilities.

United Kingdom

Access the most comprehensive UK legal collection available online, featuring reported and unreported judgments, complete legislative history since 1235, and more ...

Spain

Access Spain's largest legal collection with over 7 million court judgments, comprehensive legislation, and specialized practical resources including forms, contracts, and editorially maintained practice notes - all enhanced by Vincent AI's Spanish language capabilities.

View All
